# Engine API surface

A flat, one-line-per-symbol catalog of every public export, grouped by import
path. **Read this first when authoring a consumer** to find an existing helper
before hand-rolling one. Generated from `package.json` exports + JSDoc;
regenerate with `npm run docs:api`.

Most core symbols are also re-exported from the `@pierre/ecs` root (a few are
subpath-only). A `— —` marks an export whose JSDoc summary is missing.

### `@pierre/ecs/modules/timer`
- **`finished`** _(fn)_ — Whether the timer has reached zero. `'once'` timers stay finished once they hit zero; `'repeating'` timers report the per-tick wrap edge.
- **`fraction`** _(fn)_ — Elapsed progress in `[0, 1]` (0 at full duration, 1 at zero). Remaining progress is `1 - fraction(t)`. A zero-duration timer reads as `1`.
- **`justFinished`** _(fn)_ — Whether the timer reached/passed zero on the most recent tickTimer.
- **`makeTimer`** _(fn)_ — Create a Timer of `durationMs`, ready to start counting down.
- **`restart`** _(fn)_ — Reset the timer to full (optionally changing the duration).
- **`tickTimer`** _(fn)_ — Advance `t` by `dtMs`. A `'once'` timer clamps to zero and latches; a `'repeating'` timer wraps (coalescing multiple wraps in one tick in...
- **`Timer`** _(interface)_ — A countdown value. Embeddable anywhere — an entity component (see `modules/lifetime`, `modules/cooldown`) or a plain field on game state ...
- **`TimerMode`** _(type)_ — Whether a Timer stops at zero or wraps and runs again.
- **`timerSchema`** _(const)_ — Flat schema for embedding Timer fields in a `simpleComponent`.

### `@pierre/ecs/modules/tween`
- **`makeTween`** _(fn)_ — Create a Tween from `from` to `to` over `durationMs`. Defaults to a `linear` curve and `'once'` mode; pass `'repeating'` to loop.
- **`resetTween`** _(fn)_ — Restart the tween from the beginning. Optionally retarget `from`/`to` and the duration in one call (e.g. to chase a new value).
- **`tickTween`** _(fn)_ — Advance the tween by `dtMs` and return the new eased value.
- **`Tween`** _(interface)_ — A number interpolated `from → to` over `timer.durationMs` along `easing`.
- **`tweenDone`** _(fn)_ — Whether a `'once'` tween has reached `to` (a `'repeating'` tween's per-wrap edge).
- **`tweenValue`** _(fn)_ — Current eased value without advancing time.
